title: Task Board
description: The Group Admin's Task Board shows the group board and a board for each provider, with a colour-coded count for every status (Blocked, To-do, In Progress, In Analysis, Pending Review, Networked). Click Create task to start a new task.

title: Create Task - Group Level
description: Create Task opens on Task level. Group level is selected by default and can cover several providers. Its types are Initial Contracting, Renegotiating / Recontracting, Credentialing, Demographic Update and Generic Task (Other).

title: Create Task - Individual Level
description: Choose Individual level for work on one provider. Its types are Credentialing, Recredentialing, Demographic Update and Generic Task (Other). Credentialing adds one specific provider to a group contract.

title: Select Payers
description: Select the payers the task applies to. Each payer shows an Auto badge when automation is available for it. Here Alignment Healthcare and AzAHP are selected, and the dialog shows how many payers are chosen. Click Next.

title: Assign Providers
description: The second page shows the selected payers as chips at the top. Pick the providers for the task from the list, with a search by name or NPI and a Select all option. The task title is filled in from your choice and a short description is required.

title: Provider Selected
description: Here Ethan Brooks is selected, and the dialog shows how many providers are chosen. One task is created for each selected provider. Complete the title and description, then click Create Task.

title: Task Created
description: The new Credentialing task now appears on Ethan Brooks's board. The status counts show 2 To-do, one for each selected payer.

title: Provider Dashboard
description: Ethan Brooks signs in and sees the new work on his dashboard: Active Tasks, Networked, Blocked and Notifications. A Documents requested notification points him to My Tasks.

title: My Tasks
description: My Tasks lists the provider's credentialing tasks with the group, the payer status counts and the overall status. The new Credentialing task shows as ToDo.

title: Payer Breakdown
description: Expanding the task shows the status of each payer. Both AzAHP and Alignment Healthcare are To-do. The provider can follow progress here but only the Group Admin changes statuses.

title: Task Payers
description: On the Group Admin's board, expanding the task lists each payer with its Auto badge, Forms, attachment and comment counts, and a status control. Click a payer name to open its details.

title: Payer Documents
description: The payer dialog opens on Documents. Document Compliance shows 7/7 uploaded, with each required document such as the Medical License, DEA Certificate, Board Certification and Malpractice Insurance Certificate, and its expiry date. When automation is available, a banner offers Review automation.

title: Attachments and Notes -- Not present
description: In case if document is not uploaded/fetched from CAQH then we can manually upload from here.

title: Attachments and Notes
description: The Notes tab keeps files and notes for this payer. Use Attach file to add an attachment, or write a note about the credentialing task and click Add note.

title: Progress
description: The Progress tab lists every status change for this payer with who made it and when. It is empty until the status first changes.

title: Review Automation Letter
description: Review automation opens the credentialing letter for Alignment Healthcare. The To address is set by the Platform Admin, and you can add Cc and Bcc and edit the subject and body, which are pre-filled with the provider's details. The document checklist shows 7/7 and Filled Forms lists any payer forms. Send & Move to In Progress sends the letter and updates the status.

title: Letter Sent
description: After the letter is sent the board refreshes while the payer status is updated.

title: Status In Progress
description: Alignment Healthcare now shows In Progress with an Email badge for the sent letter. The counts at the top of the task move to 1 To-do and 1 In Progress.

title: Provider Sees Progress
description: The provider's My Tasks page reflects the change. Alignment Healthcare is In Progress and AzAHP is still To-do.

title: Change Status
description: Click a payer's status control to change it. The options are Networked, Blocked, To-do, In Progress, In Analysis, Pending Review, Not Applicable and Archived. The current status is checked.

title: Status History
description: The Progress tab now records the change from ToDo to InProgress, with the Group Admin's name, the date and the time.

title: Add a Note
description: Add a note about the payer, here that the status needs to change to Networked, so the next person sees why. Notes are saved with the payer and counted on the board.

title: Confirm Status Change
description: Choosing a new status opens Confirm Status Change. It shows the change, here In Progress to Networked, with an optional note and an optional attachment.

title: Note and Attachment
description: Add a note explaining the change and attach a supporting file, such as a PDF, then click Confirm. Cancel closes the dialog without changing anything.

title: Updating
description: The status is being saved. The note and the attachment are stored with the change.

title: Networked
description: Alignment Healthcare is now Networked. The task counts show 1 To-do and 1 Networked, and the payer row shows 1 attachment and 2 comments from the change.

title: Notification
description: At the end you will get a notification that you have been networked with this payor.
